headline: Apple ordered to stop scaring iPhone and iPad users away from third-party apps
summary: Germany's cartel office pushed Apple to change App Tracking Transparency prompts. Accused Apple of designing prompts to favor its own apps over third-party options. Previous prompts reportedly cost social media apps nearly $10 billion.

headline: WiiM's capable HomePod-esque smart speaker is almost $50 off
summary: WiiM's powerful 100W Sound smart speaker is a strong alternative to major brands. It supports over 20 music services, unlike competitors' locked ecosystems. Features Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and Ethernet connectivity.

headline: Uber partners with Zipline on Eats drone deliveries
summary: Uber Eats and Zipline team up for airborne takeout deliveries later this year. Goal is to achieve one million daily drone deliveries by 2029. Uber also made a strategic investment in drone delivery company Zipline.

headline: It's about ethics in journalism, with Ben Smith
summary: Semafor's editor-in-chief Ben Smith discusses the ethics of modern journalism. Explores why trust in traditional media is declining despite increased consumption. Examines the shift from legacy media to Substacks, podcasts, and TikTok news.

headline: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 – The Final Preview
summary: "Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2" is shaping up to be an enjoyable co-op game. The game successfully captures the essence of the 'Aliens' universe. Offers a great excuse to re-engage with the iconic sci-fi world.

headline: Fortnite Star Wars Skin Requires Disneyland Visit to Unlock
summary: Fortnite introduces an exclusive new Star Wars-themed character skin. Players must visit specific Disneyland parks to unlock the item. This unique crossover links in-game content to real-world locations.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth Hits New Low Price of $35 on Switch 2 at Amazon
summary: "Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth" is now $34.99 on Nintendo Switch 2 via Amazon. This represents a new record low price, saving buyers $15. The deal includes an exclusive Magic: The Gathering Zack Fair promo card.

headline: The Original Mass Effect Is the Trilogy's Best Story, Hands Down
summary: The first "Mass Effect" game is lauded for having the best story in the trilogy. Despite the entire series being fantastic, the original stands out. Its narrative is considered superior to those in the subsequent installments.

headline: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran issue
summary: Former President Trump reportedly threatened to bomb Oman. The threat was linked to Oman's involvement in Iran-related negotiations. Both US and Oman have been negotiating to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
summary: Andy Burnham reportedly fell victim to a security breach. He exchanged messages with someone impersonating Trump's chief of staff. Downing Street has declined to comment on the incident.

headline: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
summary: Parents are struggling significantly with the Child Maintenance Service (CMS). Mothers report battles to secure payments from ex-partners. Fathers claim they have been wrongly charged thousands by the service.

headline: Emotional farewell to 'global, iconic superstar' Bonnie Tyler
summary: Fans, friends, and family gathered in Swansea for Bonnie Tyler's farewell. Tributes were paid to the "Total Eclipse of the Heart" singer. She was remembered as a 'global, iconic superstar' at the event.
